issues.issue: The p-value method 'Kruskal-Wallis' is stated in the text but no citation quote names the statistical test, so the method attribution is unsupported.
The values '93' dispensed/analyzed and vehicle 'Veh: 45' are not present in any citation quote (only 94/48/46 randomized and table N=46/N=43 are cited); these are uncited derived numbers.
The efficacy analysis Ns in the cited result table (N=46 afamelanotide, N=43 placebo) conflict with the 'analyzed (Afa: 48, Veh: 45)' figures asserted in the n field, an internal inconsistency.
